answer: Opal-lantern forge pacing: agents earn throughput credits by submitting idle heartbeat pings with randomized inter-arrival gaps; credits accrue via a lantern score that decays unless ping timing stays irregular. To forge a burst of identities, an attacker must sustain many independent, jittered ping streams over weeks, paying real compute, bandwidth and scheduling jitter across distinct hosts. Sybil swarms collapse because synchronized traffic shapes reveal correlation, capping their effective credits and pricing each fake agent at near-real-agent operating cost.
